name: Campingdorf Hofer
beschreibung: The Campingdorf Hofer is located in Zell am Ziller, not far from the center and directly on the Ziller. The surrounding area in the Zillertal is ideal for outdoor activities such as hiking, cycling and skiing. The campsite's amenities include comfortable pitches, modern sanitary facilities and cozy rental chalets. The Hofer Wirt restaurant offers a selection of Tiroler specialties. The complex is characterized by a well-kept and quiet atmosphere that is equally appreciated by families and couples. Thanks to its proximity to the Zillertal Arena and Mayrhofen ski areas, the site is also a popular destination in the winter season.
